label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Spieth’s Slump Insight
items.text: Alan Shipnuck suggests Jordan Spieth’s 2026 struggles might require changes in his inner circle, as Spieth has no top-10s in 15 starts and kept the same coach and caddie for years.

items.headline: McIlroy’s US Open Call
items.text: Rory McIlroy predicts a particularly tough winning score at the upcoming US Open, noting the tournament's reputation as golf's most brutal challenge.

items.headline: Stricker on LIV Golf Return
items.text: Steve Stricker says he'd welcome former LIV Golf players like Mickelson and Westwood back on PGA Tour Champions if LIV ends, but acknowledges possible consequences as they did leave the tour.
